comment: Post-launch maintenance acceptance of a release candidate (docs/RELEASING.md 2a), a fixed alternative to crosspoint-acceptance/1 (acceptance-v1.json, unchanged). The two DOGEAR flagships are physically accepted; the other six packages are CI-verified only and claim no physical check. The two production-503 checks are host-covered with the candidate's own post-launch-host-evidence.json. Read by scripts/release/candidate.py.
authorization: The owner authorizes post-launch maintenance acceptance for this release: x4-gd and x4pro-gpd are physically accepted; x4-g, x4pro-g, x4pro-gd, x4pro-p, x4pro-pd and x4pro-gp are CI-verified only and not physically accepted.

checks.install-bytes: X4: the file on the card hashes to its SHA256SUMS.txt line before installing. X4 Pro: all four regions (bootloader 0x0, partitions 0x8000, boot_app0 0xe000, app 0x10000) report 'Hash of data verified.' with the candidate's pieces and app; NVS is never written.
checks.boots: Boots to Home, with no reset loop.
checks.apps-exact: Home > Apps lists exactly the package's apps plus Tools, nothing else.
checks.tools-open: Calculator and Calendar open, plus Clock on the X4 Pro.
checks.book-reads: A book opens and turns pages.
checks.update-check: Settings > System > Check for updates offers nothing older.
checks.dogear-opens: DOGEAR opens to a valid screen (an issue, CACHED, or one status screen), with no crash.
checks.dogear-e2-no-issue-on-device: No /dogear; Wi-Fi off: NO ISSUE ON THIS DEVICE and its note, exact copy.
checks.dogear-v2-cache-offline: Fixture R (schema 2) as the only SD generation, Wi-Fi off: the regular cover matches its mock sheet; every page opens; CACHED.
checks.dogear-v3-q1-cover: Fixture Q1 (schema 3), Wi-Fi off: the Quiet A cover matches its mock sheet: SOME QUIET THIS WEEK with the exact approved note; one featured lead, first; the fixture's supporting rows; no ALSO THIS WEEK head; pager 1 / N; CACHED.
checks.dogear-v3-q1-pages: Fixture Q1: every item page, 2 to N-1, opens in order and matches the sheet; the final page shows the QR.
checks.dogear-v3-q1-navigation: Fixture Q1: Next and Previous step one page each way; Next from the final page returns to the cover; Back exits to Apps; reopening shows the cover again.
checks.dogear-v3-q2-cover: Fixture Q2 (schema 3, 5 items, the 5th row deferred off the cover): as dogear-v3-q1-cover, with the fixture's rows.
checks.dogear-v3-q2-pages: Fixture Q2: as dogear-v3-q1-pages; the 5th item has its own page.
checks.dogear-no-writes-offline: After dogear-v2-cache-offline and the Q1 and Q2 checks (all with Wi-Fi off), the test /dogear files are byte-identical to what was placed. (Post-launch, an online DOGEAR run may rightly replace the card's generation with the published issue, so only the offline checks can be no-write.)
checks.settings-kept: X4 Pro: the Wi-Fi network and settings are kept after the install.

dogear-e3-cant-load.policy: Physical E3 is not a release gate. Host E3 coverage is mandatory.
dogear-e3-cant-load.scenario: No /dogear; on a Wi-Fi network without internet: CAN’T LOAD AN ISSUE and its note, exact copy.
dogear-e3-cant-load.reason: Not physically reproduced: Wi-Fi association without upstream internet would require disrupting or reconfiguring the household network solely for this test (owner amendment, 2026-10-11). Never a physical check and never a physical PASS; the candidate run itself must produce e3-host-evidence.json for its own commit, every test below PASS and none skipped.

dogear-e1-no-issue-yet.policy: Post-launch, production never again answers 503 'nothing published', and a candidate build cannot be pointed at another host. This check is host-covered: physical acceptance cannot reproduce it.
dogear-e1-no-issue-yet.scenario: No readable /dogear generation; online; the issue server's first manifest answer is 503 'nothing published' (the router's 'empty' store), explicitly framed.
dogear-e1-no-issue-yet.reason: Replaces the physical acceptance-v1 check of the same id: the exact production answer classifies as nothing published (and nothing else does), the screen rule then shows NO ISSUE YET, and that screen's heading and note are exactly the approved copy.

dogear-v2-cache-503.policy: Post-launch, production never again answers 503 'nothing published', and a candidate build cannot be pointed at another host. This check is host-covered: physical acceptance cannot reproduce it.
dogear-v2-cache-503.scenario: A hash-verified schema-2 generation on the card; online; the first manifest answer is 503 'nothing published'.
dogear-v2-cache-503.reason: Replaces the physical acceptance-v1 check of the same id: the cached regular issue is the one loaded (verified against its hash), and with nothing published the screen is CACHED, never NO ISSUE YET.
